capture_source: Packaged rc1 candidate on macOS and Windows, captured on a GitHub-hosted or owner-designated QA machine after the freeze.
rules: Every live shot needs a receipt for the exact captured state before it may replace its concept twin.
Dialogue in every shot is synthetic; no real meeting, transcript or user content is captured.
Concept shots are produced before the freeze from the designed UI; live shots are captured from rc1.

shots.framing: Full-screen 3840x2160 capture, overlay docked at the top edge beside a synthetic meeting workspace.
shots.action: Overlay slides in, holds idle for two seconds, then expands its first panel.
shots.prerequisites: rc1 installed on a clean profile; synthetic workspace window open.

shots.framing: Designed render at 3840x2160 with the same layout as SH-01L.
shots.action: Same motion as SH-01L, with the concept label held on screen throughout.
shots.prerequisites: Designed overlay frames; no product capture needed.

shots.framing: Full-screen capture with the overlay and its notes panel in frame.
shots.action: Approved sample dialogue plays from a synthetic recording while notes form in the panel.
shots.prerequisites: rc1 with the approved sample dialogue file; live receipt covering capture, transcript and note output.

shots.framing: Designed render with a synthetic dialogue strip beside a notes panel.
shots.action: Same beat as SH-02L, with the reconstruction label held on screen throughout.
shots.prerequisites: Designed frames and the synthetic dialogue script; no product capture needed.

shots.framing: Full-screen capture with the Hindsight panel open over the synthetic workspace.
shots.action: User types a question about prior context; a bounded answer streams in and settles.
shots.prerequisites: rc1 with a synthetic prior-meeting history seeded; memory proof evidence record at LIVE_VERIFIED.

shots.framing: Designed render of the Hindsight panel with the same layout as SH-03L.
shots.action: Same question and bounded answer as SH-03L, with the concept memory label held on screen throughout.
shots.prerequisites: Designed frames and the synthetic question and answer text; no product capture needed.
